serial_phase_projection.method: Subtract the sum of the chosen Mesh intervals from elapsed enqueue-commit-to-final-settlement time, optionally add the matching Oban sum, then divide each pair's 128 jobs by that projected duration. Claim-to-first-write intervals are disjoint in every trial.

held_worker_residency_at_effect_write.phase: 64 active isolated workers and verified TLS statements blocked before the effect write. Capture both worker and tree RSS and reconcile after release.

worker_cpu_attribution_64_slot_slow.scope: Fixture-only macOS framework-omitting link and effect relay. CPU by owner comes from getrusage after worker reap, runner join, and pool close. CPU totals exclude producer and PostgreSQL.

worker_launch_prefix.scope: Fixture-only launch cutoffs with identical Mach-O images across runs. The bootstrap EOF occurs before either child watchdog and before handler work. Child wait4 CPU covers launch through exit. No PostgreSQL or completed job throughput was measured.

worker_fork_bootstrap_eof.scope: Exact-image component screen. Every forked child ran the fixture's native startup code and original compiled Mesh entry, returned its own PID marker and bootstrap EOF diagnostic, and was reaped. No valid context, watchdog startup, handler execution, or end-to-end benchmark.

template_launch_handoff.scope: Disposable Unix descriptor handoff and wait ownership. Loss of the runner-owned control stream prevents entry before grant and ends a granted test child. After template death, kqueue reports the exit while the runner's waitpid returns ECHILD. No compiled handler or PostgreSQL settlement was exercised.

linux_clone_parent_ownership.virtualization: Apple Virtualization.framework, two vCPUs and 512 MiB, no persistent disk or network
cases: unrelated child retained by owning thread
linux_clone_parent_ownership.scope: Synthetic child lifecycle, exact Linux reap, and cleanup ownership after template death. Compiled Mesh handlers, Jobs claim and settlement, and benchmark performance were outside the fixture.

worker_fork_compiled_handler.scope: Compiled worker, exact reaps, and independently reconciled durable effects over the warmed route. CPU includes launcher and relay, including prewarm. These standalone waves do not claim or settle Jobs in PostgreSQL. An initial series with mismatched harness revisions is excluded.

worker_scheduler_deferral_after_fork.scope: Paired warmed real-handler fork diagnostic. No Jobs dispatch or settlement. Only the scheduler deferral flag varies between timed arms. Runtime-only reference linkage and REPL symbol registration are open review findings for this experimental commit.

worker_scheduler_entry_compatibility.scope: Experimental branch. Runtime-only reference linkage and live reference lanes, REPL opt-in and default versus experimental codegen are verified on macOS. Thread witnesses cover the fork and fresh exec diagnostic paths.

stock_exec_scheduler_deferral_slow_64.scope: Experimental compiled release with the stock exec Jobs runner, real claims and durable settlement, and a warmed verified-TLS fixture relay. Same Mesh image in both arms. The RSS peaks represent different numbers of live processes.

replacement_lease_replay.scope: A forced expiry after effect commit invalidates the old writer. The replacement attempt retrieves the original receipt with no additional effect insertion.

effect_transaction_lease_admission.scope: Disposable application fixture validates lease admission under a real job-row lock and reconciles commit, rollback, and idempotent replay with one durable effect. Transport, reusable session, and product integration remain open.

effect_send_admission_loopback.scope: Test-only component using a single-use permit and an established connection. Byte admission, partial and fully submitted ambiguity, and fallback denial are covered. Runner wakeup, replies, and durable checks remain open.

inrunner_effect_session_reuse_one_slot.scope: Private one-slot steady-state diagnostic with one isolated process per attempt. Production effect-session lifecycle and broader workloads remain open.

compiler_proof_support_jobs_integration.review: Independent source review found no merge regression in Jobs handler calls, test helper visibility, or callable theorem restrictions.

callable_theorem_rejections.scope: Type rejection cases with the optional native Lean proof branch disabled.
